title: Contact SUPUZZ
documentTitle: Contact SUPUZZ | Customer Support, Feedback & Bulk Orders
description: Contact the SUPUZZ team for product and order support, to report a problem or share feedback, or to ask about bulk orders of SUPUZZ products.
intro: Product questions, feedback or bulk orders — get in touch.

messagePrompts.feedback: Describe the issue. Include the product and order number, if available.
messagePrompts.bulk: Which products, how many, and where should they be delivered?
messagePrompts.education: School or program name, children’s ages, products, quantities, budget, delivery ZIP code and need-by date.
messagePrompts.gifts: Occasion, number of gifts, budget per gift, delivery ZIP code and event date.

feedback.required: Please fill in all required fields.
feedback.success: Message sent. We’ll reply by email.
feedback.error: Failed to submit inquiry. Please try again or contact us directly via email.
